==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am a member of a superhero team. We are patrolling through a futuristic city. The city exists in a virtual world.

I fall under the hypnotic spell of a cult leader. They are the villain that our team has been looking for. The villain is trying to lead my team into a trap.

The villain's plans are interrupted by the appearance of a goddess. The goddess flies above the city and reveals to everyone that the cult leader is a false god. Everyone embraces the goddess as the true leader of the world.
